hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=process.env.file_path||'';if(f&&fs.existsSync(f)){const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const m=c.match(/console\.log/g);if(m)console.error('[Hook] WARNING: '+m.length+' console.log found in '+f+' - remove before commit')}"

node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const files=execSync('git diff --name-only HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\n').filter(f=>f.match(/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/));const fs=require('fs');let found=false;files.forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)){const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(c.includes('console.log')){console.error('[Hook] WARNING: console.log in '+f);found=true}}});if(found)console.error('[Hook] Remove console.log before committing')}catch(e){}"
